The CSE has issued its final exchange bulletin confirming the listing of the Resulting Issuer Shares and commencement of trading on the Listing Date. The Resulting Issuer Shares have been assigned CUSIP 747975100 and ISIN CA7479751009.
Immediately prior to completion of the Transaction, the Company completed its previously approved change of name from "Rigel Technologies Inc." to "Quantum Vault Holding Corp." (the "

The Name Change and Consolidation became effective on November 20, 2026. Following implementation of the Consolidation and related fractional-share adjustments, 10,056,684 common shares of the Company were issued and outstanding immediately prior to completion of the Amalgamation.
The Transaction was completed pursuant to the amalgamation agreement dated November 16, 2026, as amended on November 19, 2026 (the "

On November 20, 2026, Quantum Vault and Subco amalgamated under the

Pursuant to the Amalgamation, each of the 90,566,860 issued and outstanding common shares of Quantum Vault was exchanged for one Resulting Issuer Share, resulting in the issuance of an aggregate of 90,566,860 Resulting Issuer Shares to the former shareholders of Quantum Vault (the "

"). The outstanding common share purchase warrants and compensation options of Quantum Vault were adjusted in accordance with their respective terms and the Amalgamation Agreement such that the holders thereof are now entitled to acquire securities of the Resulting Issuer in lieu of securities of Quantum Vault (collectively, the "

After giving effect to the Transaction, the Resulting Issuer has 100,623,544 Resulting Issuer Shares issued and outstanding on an undiluted basis. An aggregate of 23,857,556 Resulting Issuer Shares is reserved for issuance in connection with the Resulting Issuer Convertible Securities, resulting in 124,481,100 Resulting Issuer Shares on a fully diluted basis. Of the Resulting Issuer's capitalization, former shareholders of Quantum Vault hold approximately 90.01% (89.28% on a fully diluted basis) and shareholders of the Company prior to the Resulting Issuer Issuance hold approximately 9.99% (8.08% on a fully diluted basis).
Concurrent with completion of the Transaction, the board of directors and management of the Resulting Issuer were reconstituted (the "

"). The board of directors now comprises David Posner, Nauman Arshad, Kelly Abbott and Daniel Reynolds. David Posner serves as Chief Executive Officer, Kyle Appleby as Chief Financial Officer and Corporate Secretary, and Nauman Arshad as Chief Technology Officer.
A total of 15,000,000 Resulting Issuer Shares held by certain principals of the Resulting Issuer, as defined under
National Policy 46-201 - Escrow for Initial Public Offerings
, are subject to escrow pursuant to an escrow agreement dated November 20, 2026, among the Resulting Issuer, Marrelli Trust Company Limited, as escrow agent, and the principals (the "

"). The escrowed Resulting Issuer Shares will be released over 36 months, with 1/10 of the escrowed securities released on the Listing Date, followed by releases of 15% of the escrowed securities every six months following the Listing Date, and the remaining escrowed securities released 36 months following the Listing Date.
In addition, an aggregate of 55,000,000 Resulting Issuer Shares (the "

") held by certain shareholders of the Resulting Issuer are subject to contractual lock-up restrictions pursuant to lock-up agreements dated November 24, 2026 between the Resulting Issuer and each applicable shareholder (collectively, the "

"). Pursuant to the Lock-Up Agreements, the Locked Up Shares will be released over a period of 36 months, with 10% of the Locked Up Shares released on the Listing Date, followed by releases of 15% of the Locked Up Shares every six months following the Listing Date.

Further details regarding the Transaction, including the debt settlements, concurrent financing, Name Change, Consolidation and Board and Management Reconstitution, are set out in the Company's November 19, 2026 news release.
The Company's listing statement in respect of the Transaction (the "

Quantum Vault Holding Corp., through its wholly owned subsidiary, Quantum Vault Tech Corp., is a technology company developing hardware and software security solutions intended to address cybersecurity challenges associated with future quantum computer development. The Company previously disclosed that Quantum Vault had engineered a prototype of a quantum-AI-generated security system embedded in a fully offline cold wallet for cryptocurrencies designed to operate without phones, computers or external connectivity.
